title: deadlock match analysis
caption: Compares match conditions to find which stats are most associated with winning.
workflow: Collect match data, take comparable checkpoints and split matches by a condition. Compare win rates for economy, damage, objectives and other stats, with sample sizes and uncertainty beside each result.
benefit: The urn was one question. The bigger question was what actually matters.
demo: Change a metric threshold and compare conditional win rates with confidence intervals.
source: deadlock_analytics/urn_checkpoint_analyze.py and scripts/deadlock_metrics_lib.py; fixed-clock comparisons and conditional analyses.
boundary: Generated checkpoint fixtures. Associations do not establish that changing a stat causes a win.
